_description: Performance baseline for issue #391 PERFORMANCE slice (4 boxes: cascade BFS / HybridRetriever / BM25 rebuild / Postgres slow log). Four of the six baselines (cascade_5hop_bfs + bm25_build_1k/5k/10k) are CI-blessed from 3 workflow_dispatch runs on the feat/403-perf-baseline-rebless branch (see _blessed_from_ci_runs); the harness compares current p50/p95 wall-clock against these baselines and fails on regression beyond the documented tolerance band. The two HybridRetriever baselines (p50/p95) remain at 0.0 because the live retriever skips in CI without SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_KEY + OPENAI_API_KEY — see _placeholder_rationale on those entries and follow-up tracker referenced in the PR body. Real production targets are listed in _target_* fields for reference; baseline mean_ms values reflect the CI runner shape, not the absolute targets. When re-blessing a baseline, replicate the 3-run methodology (workflow_dispatch on the rebless branch) and update _blessed_from_ci_runs to match.
_methodology: Each of the 3 CI workflow_dispatch runs above ran scripts/run_benchmarks.sh against the in-memory _FakeSupabaseGraph (cascade) + reference BM25 builder (bm25). Per-run median_ms is captured in test-results/measurements-*.json artifacts on each run; the baseline mean_ms below is the median-of-medians across the 3 runs (median across runs = primary statistic; stdev across runs reported in _observed_variance_pct). Tolerance bands narrowed from the pre-bless defaults to honestly reflect observed CI variance — relative bands set to max(safety floor 10%, ~5x observed stdev) and absolute bands set to cover the full observed timing range (max-min across all timings in all 3 runs) plus headroom.

cascade_5hop_bfs._target_rationale: Issue #391 PERFORMANCE box 1: '< 500ms for 5-hop BFS'. Synthetic graph shape may not match production graph; tolerance band is relative to blessed baseline, not the absolute target.
cascade_5hop_bfs._ci_observation: 3 CI runs (workflow_dispatch on feat/403-perf-baseline-rebless) produced per-run median_ms [352.54, 357.23, 363.27]; med-of-meds=357.23ms, stdev across runs=5.38ms (1.51%), range across 15 individual timings=20.09ms (345.95–366.04). p95 across runs was tight (med-of-p95s=365.41ms). The synthetic in-memory _FakeSupabaseGraph traverses ~1000 reachable nodes per cascade so absolute numbers reflect Python-side BFS overhead on the ubuntu-latest CI runner, NOT real Supabase round-trips. The 500ms absolute target remains the documentation anchor for an eventual real-Postgres measurement.
cascade_5hop_bfs._tolerance_rationale: 10% relative OR 50ms absolute (whichever wider). Relative band is the safety floor (~7x observed stdev/med = 1.51%), kept at 10% so genuine drift surfaces but routine CI jitter does not. Absolute band 50ms (was 100ms placeholder) covers >2x the observed full-timing range (20.09ms across 15 samples in 3 runs) — narrowed to honestly reflect observed CI variance per #403.

hybrid_retriever_search_p50._target_rationale: Issue #391 PERFORMANCE box 2: '< 200ms for fused search'. Live retriever in CI skips when SUPABASE_URL/OPENAI_API_KEY absent; baseline is blessed on the first environment that has both.
hybrid_retriever_search_p50._placeholder_rationale: Remains at 0.0 (placeholder) until a CI run has SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_KEY + OPENAI_API_KEY available — the test currently skips with `requires_supabase` + `sk-*` shape check. The pre-#403 36-query dev-box run (no sk-* OPENAI key — dense stream degraded gracefully to []) produced p50~336ms which was NOT representative; we deliberately do NOT re-bless from a degraded-stream measurement. Follow-up tracker for when secrets land: see PR body for #403.
hybrid_retriever_search_p50._tolerance_rationale: 20% relative OR 50ms absolute. Wider band than cascade because network round-trips dominate; absolute band protects against jitter. Bands carried forward from PR #401 pending CI re-bless.

hybrid_retriever_search_p95._target_rationale: Tail-latency budget: p95 should not exceed 2.5x the p50 target (200ms). 500ms is a conservative tail-latency ceiling for a 3-stream fused search.
hybrid_retriever_search_p95._placeholder_rationale: Remains at 0.0 (placeholder) for the same reason as hybrid_retriever_search_p50 — see that entry's _placeholder_rationale. The pre-#403 36-query dev-box run produced p95~1041ms (with degraded dense stream); NOT representative; we deliberately do NOT re-bless from that data.
hybrid_retriever_search_p95._tolerance_rationale: 25% relative OR 100ms absolute. p95 is noisier than p50 — wider tolerance is appropriate. Bands carried forward from PR #401 pending CI re-bless.

bm25_build_1k._ci_observation: 3 CI runs produced per-run median_ms [20.55, 21.08, 21.07]; med-of-meds=21.07ms, stdev across runs=0.30ms (1.42%), range across 9 individual timings=2.01ms (20.44–22.45). Build time for 1000-doc corpus via the reference Python BM25 implementation; corpus repeats from synthetic_corpus.jsonl to fill the slice.
bm25_build_1k._tolerance_rationale: 10% relative OR 20ms absolute (whichever wider). Relative band is the safety floor (~7x observed stdev/med = 1.42%). Absolute band 20ms (was 50ms placeholder) covers ~10x the observed full-timing range (2.01ms) — narrowed to honestly reflect observed CI variance per #403.

bm25_build_5k._ci_observation: 3 CI runs produced per-run median_ms [107.94, 111.19, 111.10]; med-of-meds=111.10ms, stdev across runs=1.85ms (1.66%), range across 9 individual timings=6.33ms (106.80–113.14).
bm25_build_5k._tolerance_rationale: 10% relative OR 30ms absolute (whichever wider). Same band shape as 1k slice; absolute floor widens because total work is ~5x. ~6x observed stdev/med relative band. Absolute band 30ms (was 100ms placeholder) covers ~5x the observed full-timing range (6.33ms) — narrowed to honestly reflect observed CI variance per #403.

bm25_build_10k._ci_observation: 3 CI runs produced per-run median_ms [224.85, 222.14, 216.50]; med-of-meds=222.14ms, stdev across runs=4.26ms (1.92%), range across 9 individual timings=12.21ms (215.35–227.56).
bm25_build_10k._tolerance_rationale: 10% relative OR 50ms absolute (whichever wider). Same band shape as 1k/5k slices; absolute floor widens because total work is ~10x. ~5x observed stdev/med relative band. Absolute band 50ms (was 200ms placeholder) covers ~4x the observed full-timing range (12.21ms) — narrowed to honestly reflect observed CI variance per #403.
